decisive_signal_definitions.KNOWN_GENERATED_HASH_MATCH: Content hash is byte-identical to media another provenance manifest already classifies SYNTHETIC / GENERATED_IMAGE. Independently sufficient to disqualify.
decisive_signal_definitions.EMBEDDED_GENERATOR_PROVENANCE: A recognized provenance/content-credential structure (C2PA/JUMBF, IPTC digitalSourceType, structured softwareAgent metadata) names a generative producer or trainedAlgorithmicMedia. Independently sufficient to disqualify.

what_is_NOT_proof_of_generation: Missing EXIF is NOT proof of generation. Real photographs routinely lose EXIF to messaging apps, editors, export pipelines, privacy stripping, and format conversion.
A container/extension mismatch (PNG bytes under a .jpg name) is NOT proof of generation. It is a content-type/integrity anomaly only.
File mtime is NOT proof of generation. Timestamps are trivially alterable and carry no provenance weight.
Missing Make, Model, or DateTimeOriginal is NOT proof of generation and is not evaluated at all.
A producer name appearing in arbitrary raw bytes or in ordinary textual image content is NOT proof of generation. Producer-name matching is valid only inside a recognized provenance structure.
asymmetry_rule: Positive generated provenance MAY disqualify REAL_PHYSICAL. Absence of generated provenance MUST NOT establish REAL_PHYSICAL. Qualification always requires a valid operator provenance declaration plus the physical-capture gate.
